# Current corpus discovery repair

The [hosted observation](hosted-01/observations-01.json) identifies failed run
37414784239, public head `5bcc36f868fdddc4f68d1d715b83ad8e8aeeb726`, and tested
merge `12e78df720405ae46fdb7c2ce7674d3e67708305`. Exact small log excerpts retain
the first failure, successful round-trip body and distinct distribution limit.
The distribution wrapper reports Cargo exit 101; its inner retained stderr
was not inspected. This packet does not infer that internal cause.

The [original test](native_roundtrip-before-repair.rs.txt) expected six current
snapshots and restricted all of them to the namespace migration directory.
Current intake already records six namespace and two coherent-basis snapshots.
The repair requires both counts and each exact logical provider/project path;
it retains 101 logical projects, 87 corpus roots, 14 examples, original-source
and other historical-snapshot exclusions, re-encoding and evidence-cache checks.
It changes no source-selection implementation, corpus source, pins or notices.

The [observed inputs](observed-inputs-01.json) bind the selected native build and
declared test/selector/manifest inputs. They were captured while commands were
running and do not describe a complete build closure or portable attestation.
[Latest Rust](validation-01/latest-native-roundtrip-01.json) and
[Rust 1.85.0](validation-01/msrv-native-roundtrip-01.json) each passed all five
existing tests. Other checks and immutable stream identities are recorded in
the [local validation](validation-01/local-validation-01.json).

No maximum-size case, new generic QFT work, Lean build/audit/replay, full hosted
CI success, fresh-install success, proof discharge or release is claimed.
Constitutional continuity uses trusted base
`faa5cfb5e7ea1cf3b39a43b80f7f2345e89197c2`. The two admitted ordinary QLV1
ownership/scope guarantees retain their exact scopes; broader QS, PR,
quantitative RS and EXACT duties remain pending.
